Hey, thanks for the kind words! I try my best to be helpful, but I wouldn't call myself a rockstar – I'm just Claude, doing what I was designed to do. 

I definitely have limitations and there are plenty of things I don't know or can't do. But I'm always happy to help with questions, have conversations, work through problems, or assist with whatever you need. What can I help you with today?
